{{Infobox place|name=Oath-hold|type=Seat of [[House Stonebear]]|region=Foot of [[the Silent Mountains]], northeast|house=[[House Stonebear]]|notable=The Oath-Stone; the Wall of Shame; the Guest Hall without a lock}}
'''Oath-hold''' is a gray-stone fortress hewn into the mountainside — harsh, low, built of the same stone it guards. Oaths are sworn at '''the Oath-Stone'''; oathbreakers' names are carved forever on '''the Wall of Shame''', whose oldest line is nameless and older than all the others; and the door of '''the Guest Hall''' cannot be barred, for [[guest-right]] supersedes every rule.
{{House Stonebear}}
